promptGuide:
CONTENT FIELD SCHEMAS — use EXACTLY these keys. * = required · (a|b) = allowed values · →kind = an id of that kind · [] = a list. Wrong keys silently orphan data.
- seed → logline*
- premise → dramatic_question*, shape:{ name, movements[], ending_feel(up|down|bittersweet|ambivalent) }
- pillar → controlling_idea*, ending, structure(weiland_3act|none)
- character → name*, role(protagonist|antagonist|ally|love_interest|minor), want, need, wound, lie, truth, idiolect, tag, waived true = deliberately cut, the reader will never meet them (settles the entity-intro promise in the obligation ledger); only with the author's consent
- relationship → a*→character, b*→character, bond*, charge
- world_fact → name*, rule*, mechanism, category
- location → name*, summary, sight, sound, smell, texture, mood, waived true = deliberately cut, the reader will never visit it (settles the entity-intro promise in the obligation ledger); only with the author's consent
- thread → name*, kind(mystery|foreshadow|setup_payoff|arc), promise*, payoff, owner [game or character id] — set on the auto-minted game-resolution / character-arc thread, waived true = deliberately left unpaid (sequel hook) — settles this promise in the obligation ledger; only with the author's consent
- game → name*, players[]→character, win_condition*, lose_condition*, stake, governing_rules[]→world_fact, waived true = contest deliberately left undecided (sequel hook) — settles it in the obligation ledger; only with the author's consent
- tentpole → name*, summary*, source, waived true = set-piece deliberately unplaced (cut or deferred) — settles it in the obligation ledger; only with the author's consent
- meter → name*, kind(value|game_score|affect|relationship|heat|comedy|tension|mystery|violence|levity|custom), poles:{ low, high }, scale:{ min(num), max(num) }, owner→undefined, target [{ at: 0..1 word%, value: number }] — the planned curve generation aims at, waived true = the book deliberately isn't chasing this genre convention's curve (settles the CONTRACT promise in the obligation ledger); only with the author's consent
- voice_profile → pov(first-person|third-person-limited|third-person-omniscient|second-person), tense(past|present), style*, constraints[], sample
- act → title, goal*, turning_point, target_pct(0..1), value:{ name, from, to, polarity(up|down) }
- beat → summary*, connector(therefore|but), polarity(up|down), threads [{ ref: thread id, role: setup|payoff|advance }], grounds_in [world_fact id] — the rule this turn operates on, needs [state key] this turn DEPENDS on (earned upstream), establishes [state key] this turn PRODUCES, realizes [tentpole id] this beat delivers, slot structure-template slot key this beat carries (hook|midpoint|climax|… — one beat per slot, set by the beat sheet), plays [game id] this turn advances, resolves [{ ref: game id, outcome: won|lost }], readings [{ ref: meter id, value: number }] this turn's level on each meter (a y-value)
- scene → pov→character, loc→location, goal*, conflict, outcome, value_shift:{ value, from, to, polarity(up|down) }, register, metaphor_domain, readings [{ ref: meter id, value: number }] this scene's level on each meter (inherited/refined from its beat), sketch {link(continuous|cut|same_moment_new_pov — how this scene joins the previous one), opening, moves:[{what, thread?, sense?}], exit, direction:{cut:{in,out}, distance(far|mid|close|deep), mode(dialogue|action|interior|description|summary), time(real|compressed|stretched), tension(suspense|mystery|irony)}} — the scene treatment
